data.body: S2 CLOSED (change 1939 merged). 3 of 8 stories done: S8, S1, S2 - all merged to main. S3/S4/S6 first parallel review round: all three BLOCK, 7 findings, all legitimate. Most valuable were OVER-scoping catches: S3 claimed plan-time lint parity, enrichment parity and near-miss policy were unproven but S1 had already landed all three in test_non_codebase_tag_edge.py, so S3 shrinks to the guard suites only. S4 missed docs/plan-review-gate.md:335 quoting the coach move-14 template verbatim, and lacked boundary statements vs S5 (author guide) and S7 (kind emit, which ADR 0101 requires in lockstep). S6 missed test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py (asserts the exact reworded phrases) and test_attested_close_guard_e2e.py (existing e2e for both guards). Verified the claimed 'byte-identity drift gate' on the move table does NOT exist (nearby parity test covers overlay ranges) - doc-accuracy defect, not CI break. All remediated; three re-reviews running in parallel.
